definitions.explanation: An administrative division of Japan, similar to a state or province.

examples.japanese: ⟦{千葉県|ちばけん}→千葉県：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいます→住む：00673_sumu⟧。

examples.notes: Technically 43 prefectures plus Tokyo (都), Osaka/Kyoto (府), and Hokkaido (道)

examples.japanese: ⟦{県庁|けんちょう}→県庁：27822_kenchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近|ちか}く→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The prefectural office is near the station.

notes:
{県|けん} is the most common type of administrative division in Japan. There are 43 {県|けん} out of 47 total prefectures.

JAPAN'S ADMINISTRATIVE DIVISIONS (⟦{都道府県|とどうふけん}→都道府県：14502_todoufuken⟧):
- ⟦{都|と}→都：noentry⟧: Tokyo (⟦{東京都|とうきょうと}→東京都：noentry⟧)
- ⟦{道|どう}→道：noentry⟧: Hokkaido (⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧)
- ⟦{府|ふ}→府：09870_fu⟧: Osaka (⟦{大阪府|おおさかふ}→大阪府：noentry⟧), Kyoto (⟦{京都府|きょうとふ}→京都府：noentry⟧)
- {県|けん}: the remaining 43 prefectures

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{県庁|けんちょう}→県庁：27822_kenchou⟧: prefectural government office
- ⟦{県民|けんみん}→県民：22700_kenmin⟧: prefectural residents
- ⟦{県立|けんりつ}→県立：21885_kenritsu⟧: prefectural (institution)
- ⟦{県知事|けんちじ}→県知事：22073_kenchiji⟧: prefectural governor
- ⟦{県内|けんない}→県内：27823_kennai⟧: within the prefecture

USAGE:
{県|けん} is always attached as a suffix to the prefecture name: ⟦{千葉県|ちばけん}→千葉県：noentry⟧, ⟦{愛知県|あいちけん}→愛知県：noentry⟧. When speaking casually, the {県|けん} suffix is often dropped.
